one_paragraph_summary: Writing weeks before the November 15, 2021 substitution deadline, Panganiban argues that whether or not Davao Mayor Sara Duterte agrees to substitute for Sen. Bato dela Rosa as the PDP-Laban and/or Lakas-CMD presidential bet, she will be the game changer of the political landscape. If she relents to the 'Run, Sara, Run' chorus, she gets the ruling-party logistics and 'her enviable problem would be which donations to accept and which ones to reject,' aided by an administration that can shepherd up to 10% of votes. If she declines, the likely beneficiary is Manila Mayor Isko Moreno, whose 'Healing President' posture and selective adoption of Duterte and Marcos 'good policies and projects' may even secure the Solid North via Bongbong Marcos's possible move from running mate to substitute on his ticket; Bongbong's own Federal Party (not KBL) choice is read as openness to joining PDP-Laban and actualizing Imee Marcos's Sara-Bongbong or Bongbong-Sara 'dream team.' Sen. Ping Lacson may have to 'bite the bullet' and yield to Senate President Tito Sotto, who could land in Yorme's Akyon Demokratiko, Manny Pacquiao's Promdi, PDP-Laban, or even the LP, where Kiko Pangilinan has publicly expressed willingness -- 'to his wife Sharon's comfort' -- to withdraw if it would enhance VP Leni Robredo's bid. He is critical of Leni's choice to run as an independent rather than under the LP she chairs: she 'deprived herself of the legal pluses' of the dominant minority party, no independent has ever been elected president, and abandoning the LP cadres risks loyalty erosion -- a worry he writes with the credibility of a former LP chief legal counsel under Salonga after EDSA. He warns the 'kakampinks' against preaching to the converted, citing Mocha Uson's reported 4 million likes and 1.2 million engagements campaigning for Duterte in 2016 (per a 2020 ISEAS-Yusof Ishak white paper), and recommends Penn professor Damon Centola's January 2021 book 'Change' for its insights on the 'strength of weak ties' and 'weakness of strong ties' in spreading beliefs and triggering action through social networks. Whether she runs or not, he closes, Sara will be the game changer.
